faqs.a:
The board shall hold meetings regularly, at least annually, and shall designate the
               time and place thereof. All meetings of the board shall be public; each trustee shall
               be entitled to one vote in the meetings of the board. Four trustees shall constitute
               a quorum at any meeting of the board, and a majority vote shall be determinative of
               any issue before the board. The board shall adopt its own rules of procedure and shall
               keep a record of its proceedings.
(Code 1960, § 19-2(F); Code 1981, § 26-32;
Ord. No. 4155, § 2, 2-2-2009
)
